archetype: Hybrid 4 & 5 (Swiss Brutalist Tech + Jewel Luxury Cinematic)

layout_and_spacing.global: Generous spacing around structural containers, but dense tight packing inside functional widgets.

landing_page.style: Bento Grid (Mode A) with cinematic backdrop.

control_panel.style: Control Room Grid (Mode B). Screen-filling layout (h-screen).
control_panel.container: h-screen w-full flex flex-col bg-[#050505] p-4
control_panel.playlist_col: col-span-1 md:col-span-4 lg:col-span-3 flex flex-col h-full bg-[#0A0A0A] border border-white/10 rounded-lg overflow-hidden
control_panel.player_col: col-span-1 md:col-span-8 lg:col-span-9 flex flex-col h-full gap-4

display_page.container: w-screen h-screen bg-black overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center m-0 p-0

surface_strategies.cards: Flat solid background (#0A0A0A), 1px stroke (border-white/10), NO shadow. This gives the 'hardware console' feel.
surface_strategies.glass: Used strictly for overlays/modals (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10).
surface_strategies.active_item: For playlist items that are currently playing, use bg-[#111111] with border-l-2 border-l-[#F59E0B] and primary text color for title.

buttons.primary: bg-[#F59E0B] text-black hover:bg-[#FBBF24] rounded-md font-medium px-6 py-2 transition-colors duration-150
buttons.secondary: bg-[#111111] text-white border border-white/10 hover:bg-[#1A1A1A] rounded-md px-6 py-2
buttons.icon: w-10 h-10 flex items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-[#111111] border border-white/10 hover:border-white/30 text-white transition-colors

components.sliders: Tailwind customized radix/shadcn slider. Track bg-white/10, Range bg-[#F59E0B], Thumb w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-white border-2 border-[#F59E0B].
components.inputs: bg-[#050505] border border-white/10 text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#F59E0B] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#F59E0B]

motion.transitions: Fast, hardware-like snappy transitions (duration-150 ease-out) for all buttons and hovers.
motion.display_idle: Subtle pulse animation on the idle cinema icon (animate-pulse, opacity 10% to 30%).
motion.now_playing: Animate an audio wave or simple breathing dot in gold next to the currently playing track.

images.description: Empty vintage cinema hall. Must be heavily overlaid (bg-black/80) so it feels like a subtle cinematic texture behind the landing cards.

icons.usage: Use Monitor for display route, UploadCloud for upload, Sliders or Radio for control. Play, Pause, SkipForward, SkipBack, Repeat, Volume2, VolumeX for playback.

descriptions.display: Fullskjermsvisning uten grensesnitt. Åpne på ekstern skjerm.
descriptions.upload: Last inn nye videoklipp til systemet.
descriptions.control: Styr avspilling, volum og spillelister i sanntid.

upload.dropzone: Dra og slipp videofiler her, eller klikk for å velge

instructions_to_main_agent: Add Google Fonts: Outfit (headings), Manrope (body), JetBrains Mono (timecodes/mono).
Strictly follow the color palette. Do not invent new gradients. Stick to the flat, hardware-like console aesthetic.
For the display route (/display), ensure it's pure black (`bg-black`) and hides the mouse cursor if possible when idle. No scrollbars.
For the layout grids, use CSS grid or Tailwind grid utilities exactly as specified. Do not use generic Shadcn Card layouts for the main control panel structure.
Implement WebSocket or similar state synchronization mechanism as required by the problem statement so the control panel updates the display page in real-time.
Ensure all interactive elements have the correct `data-testid`.
